gameName: Betrayal at House on the Hill

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Betrayal at House on the Hill rules (Avalon Hill, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Set the Traitor's Tome and Secrets of Survival aside until the haunt
Each player picks a character: board, figure and base, with 4 clips on the green starting numbers
Event, Item and Omen cards in three shuffled facedown decks; dice within reach
Monster and Traitor reference cards faceup; a Player reference card each
The three starting tiles in the center, 8-10 inches apart; other room tiles shuffled facedown
All explorers on the Entrance Hall
Choose one of the five Scenario cards together; box the rest
Number Track, pointer and tokens aside for the haunt
The player whose explorer has the next birthday goes first; play is clockwise
